description.value: Cravings Brookswood Restaurant presents itself online as a Korean food destination offering fried chicken, kimchi rice, mussel soup, and traditional dishes available for online ordering. The OSM record places it in the Brookswood area of Langley, but the website lists a Vancouver (Davie St) address, raising significant uncertainty about whether the business still operates at the mapped location. The relaxed, cozy environment described on the site would otherwise be a welcome stop for cyclists in the Fraser Valley.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (5 spaces, covered) at 73m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places 'Cravings' at 114 200 Street in the Brookswood/Langley area (coordinates ~49.076, -122.670) and tags it as a cafe/coffee_shop. However, the website for cravingsbrookswood.com describes 'Cravings Brookswood Restaurant' as a Korean food restaurant (fried chicken, kimchi, etc.) and lists a completely different address — 1738 Davie St, Vancouver, BC V6G 1W3 — suggesting the business has either relocated to Vancouver or the discovered URL does not correspond to the OSM node. No cyclist-relevant amenity information appears on the website.
concerns: Critical address mismatch: OSM shows 114 200 Street (Brookswood/Langley) but website lists 1738 Davie St, Vancouver, BC V6G 1W3 — the business may have relocated or the discovered URL may not correspond to this OSM node.
Cuisine/category mismatch: OSM tags the record as cafe/coffee_shop but the website describes a Korean food restaurant (fried chicken, kimchi, sausage, etc.).
Name mismatch: OSM name is 'Cravings' but the website uses 'Cravings Brookswood Restaurant'.
Very small website payload (1138 bytes) showing a Vancouver address may indicate a placeholder page for a business that has relocated away from the mapped location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The website address (1738 Davie St, Vancouver) directly contradicts the OSM address (114 200 Street, Langley/Brookswood), and the business type (Korean restaurant) conflicts with the OSM cuisine tag (coffee_shop). It is unclear whether the business still physically operates at the OSM coordinates.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags cuisine=coffee_shop but website presents the business as a Korean food restaurant; the broad Food & Drink category is still appropriate.
